ensure-cf-project.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw staging-context-md || npx wrangler pages project create staging-context-md --production-branch main

deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/context-md --project-name staging-context-md --branch main

manual-deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/context-md --project-name staging-context-md --branch main

ensure-cf-project:production.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw production-context-md || npx wrangler pages project create production-context-md --production-branch production

deploy:production.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/context-md --project-name production-context-md --branch production

ensure-cf-project:preview.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw preview-context-md || npx wrangler pages project create preview-context-md --production-branch main

deploy:preview.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/context-md --project-name preview-context-md --branch "$PREVIEW_BRANCH" --commit-hash "${PREVIEW_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
